name: Leva
category: A9. Adjacent resources mentioned during discovery
role: React control panel for live-tweaking values; human-facing only
summary: React hook-based panel (useControls) rendering sliders, colour pickers and folders that feed values into a scene, popular with react-three-fiber. It is interactive-only: values change by human input, not by an agent. Useful for authoring sessions to find parameters, then hard-coding them.
use_when: A human tuning R3F scene values interactively before they are written to files
avoid_when: Keyframed parameter curves with export: theatre-js
Agent-driven runs: set parameters via props or JSON, no panel
Non-React scenes: a plain lil-gui panel, or none

assessment.rationale: Active, but a React GUI for humans to tweak values; no CLI or headless route an agent can drive, and VCR parameters live in files. Theatre.js covers editable parameter curves with export.
